[RDSC.6a.2.7] `ServiceKwarg.ds_type` is the kwarg's declared type. For a schema
the compiler must write the schema's own name ([LIMP.13.2]), as the file declaring
the service resolves it ([LIMP.1.5]). For any other type it must write the name
the declaration spells: a builtin type, a unit symbol, a dimension or scalar-group
name, the kind `Schema`, or an opaque type. Nothing identifies a type other than a
schema by that text ([LUNI.4.1.5]).
